Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Board asks us to confirm renewed pricing and SLA targets by end of month. Can you confirm:

- Final renewal price for our reserved pool (Q4 start).
- Any upcoming maintenance windows that would impact our migration plan.

I attached a one-pager with our desired timelines. Little urgency on our side but want to get the internal finance approval process moving.

Cheers,

Subject: Re: Renewal timing and exec ask

Lia — thanks, got it. Short answers up front:

- Renewal price: pending final legal/discount approval but current committed offer is $295k/year for the reserved pool (same capacity as current commit).
- Maintenance: no scheduled infra maintenance in the proposed renewal window; we'll mark a blackout for their migration week in Dec if they sign.

Can I loop in finance and my renewal lead to run a quick commit validation? Marissa, Naomi, Aditya — can you confirm the internal checkpoint list below and whether we can move this to contract draft next week?

Quick checklist for internal confirmation:
- Pricing approval (discount tier and CAC credits)
- SLA exception paperwork (if needed)
- Commercial terms (payment terms, PO process)
- IT security questionnaire closure status

I will prepare a brief commit-clearance checklist and share a draft MA for their review. Lia — I'll send a proposed calendar with two 30-min slots for next week for a sign-off call.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Triton_Renewal_MA_v2.pdf (draft MA stub)

All — quick update from finance ops after an initial skim of the numbers:

- $295k/year looks fine but needs CFO approval for the applied onboarding credit.
- We should expect standard 60-day net payment; Triton may push for 45. Recommend we keep 60 and offer a one-time 15-day discount incentive (3% of TCV) if they sign by Nov 30.
- I uploaded a commit-clearance spreadsheet with the revenue recognition flags. See attachment.

Ask: Dylan, can you confirm whether the reserved pool capacity matches their current peak usage? If not, we should call that out in the MA and include an autoscale addendum.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. RevOps Manager
Redwood Inference

1) I send Triton the draft MA (attached) with an explicit autoscale addendum and a 60-day payment term + 3% early-sign credit.
2) Naomi, can you confirm whether Security Ops needs any additional attestation or doc before we hand draft to legal?
3) Marissa, if finance is ok with the early-sign structure, can you mark the deal record for CFO review?

I'll also propose two times for a 30-min sign-off call with Triton: Mon Nov 22 10:00am PT or Tue Nov 23 2:00pm PT. Lia / Pedro — do either of those work?

Thanks,
Dylan
